cuts.alpha_source: implemented locally in compute_track_scattered_electron_alpha(); matches the established alpha(track,e) 3D opening-angle convention documented in sidis_highQ2/context-handoff.md Near-Electron / Alpha-Veto Study Save Point
cuts.input_cut_statement: Preserves the existing reco-luminorm input defaults and selection logic, with optional reco-only alpha(track,e) survivor cut applied before histogram filling when requested.

layout.legend: DJANGOH/RAPGAP line legend only in top-left panel, lower-left inside axes
layout.panel_labels: compact numeric Q2, x, z, pT_h, charge labels inside each panel

styling.data: black points with per-bin statistical errors
